sources.source_name: Amazon: Free Shipping and Low Prices Fuel 42% Unit Growth
sources.notes: Release body dated July 22 (archive header is one day earlier): Q2 2003 sales $1.1 billion (+37%), operating income $42 million, net loss $43 million; lower prices/free shipping and third-party sellers supported growth. Full-year 2003 profit is outside the August 2003 endpoint and excluded.

Contemporary earnings release: fiscal 2003 revenue $32.19 billion, 13% growth; over 9.4 million Xbox consoles sold since the 2001 launch. Profit comparisons across this era are avoided because later statements changed stock compensation accounting.
